# Module user-displayable exceptions not working anymore

The pull request https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/14239 adds the possibility for modules to display error on controllers thanks to the exception ModuleErrorException.

But because of this commit https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/commit/a5619cc54a121e553b3aeb46ef2076c2a6b58f20 all modules exceptions are catch during the call of callHookOn method.

With this try/catch, the exception is no longer raised to the FrameworkBundleAdminController class and the error is not displayed to user.

## Attendu
Throw an exception that implements `\PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Module\Exception\ModuleErrorInterface` inside a module should display an error message for users.

For example :
```
public function hookActionAfterUpdateCustomerFormHandler(array $params)
 {
     throw new CustomException('This is a nice display message');
 }
```

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6272184/216982428-ba07e818-4870-4b28-8025-4733460ae17b.png)

## Étapes
- Install [attached module](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/10663154/module_for_pr_hook_error.zip)
- Go to Back-Office customer page
- Update a customer
- No message is displayed to the user
